entry.name: dict.route
entry.description: Use the dict.route object to compare two dictionaries. If the dictionary received at the left inlet meets the specifications set by the dictionary at the right inlet, then pass the dictionary through the left outlet. Otherwise passes the dictionary through the right outlet.
